meta.title: Replace [KnownBuiltin] string-based comparisons with enum-based system
meta.body_summary: Replace string-based [KnownBuiltin] identification with enum-based system in the Slang compiler for faster builtin lookups and type safety.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot replaced string‑based builtin lookups with an enum, iterating through review feedback to adopt preprocessor syntax and fix a regression; merged after approvals.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 8084 changed lines across 135 files, this is a large refactor by absolute volume, though much churn comes from adding/removing temporary AST dump files and merging master. The core performance change is concentrated in ~10 source files. Successful merge after intensive review and multiple fix rounds fits a collaborative, iterative performance improvement in a compiler codebase.

review_details.concern_detail: csyonghe requested eliminating the unnecessary string‑to‑enum conversion by using the preprocessor $(KnownBuiltinDeclName::...) syntax in meta.slang files, which required changing KnownBuiltin to store an int and updating all meta definitions.
review_details.performance_claim: Replace O(n) string comparisons with O(1) enum comparisons for identifying builtin functions, improving compile‑time performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot initially created a sub‑optimal string‑to‑enum helper; with iterative, precise guidance it adapted to a preprocessor‑based approach, showing ability to follow detailed compiler‑specific instructions while still needing human direction for correctness and design.

detection_detail.code_reading: csyonghe reviewed the implementation and pushed for a preprocessor‑based approach to avoid runtime string‑to‑enum conversion; gtong‑nv requested descriptive constants in the test.
detection_detail.load_test: csyonghe manually tested and reproduced a regression by compiling tests/autodiff/diff-ptr-type-call.slang and reported the failure.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Reviewer provided a concrete test file and compilation command to reproduce the regression; subsequent commit fixed the issue and tests passed.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After reporting a regression with IDifferentiablePtr mapping, Copilot fixed the bug in commit e880ba2b and removed the unused IDifferentiablePtrType enum case per request.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced KnownBuiltinDeclName enum in slang-ast-support-types.h, changed KnownBuiltin attribute to store int instead of string, updated core.meta.slang and hlsl.meta.slang to use preprocessor $( (int)KnownBuiltinDeclName::...) syntax, modified IRKnownBuiltinDecoration to hold enum value, and converted all string‑based builtin comparisons in IR processing files to enum comparisons.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Large line churn (≈2,800 lines) came from adding then removing temporary AST dump files; merge commit (9dc4d0f) brought in many unrelated master changes.
change_trajectory: Initial implementation added KnownBuiltinDeclName enum and getKnownBuiltinDeclNameFromString() helper.
First review: requested elimination of string conversion via preprocessor, prompting revision to store int directly in KnownBuiltin attribute.
Second review: corrected preprocessor syntax to use $( (int)KnownBuiltinDeclName::...), needing a space after '(' to avoid a preprocessor bug.
Regression report: csyonghe found IDifferentiablePtr handled incorrectly; Copilot fixed mapping and removed unused IDifferentiablePtrType case.
Test improvement: gtong-nv requested a descriptive constant in the test; fix applied via follow‑up commit.
Final review: gtong-nv approved, and jkwak-work gave LGTM; PR merged after 4 days.

review_signals.summary: Requested replacing string‑to‑enum conversion by using preprocessor $(KnownBuiltinDeclName::...) syntax in meta files to avoid runtime overhead entirely.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot reworked the approach to store int directly and later adopted the preprocessor syntax in commit d0bade9b.

review_signals.summary: Pointed out need for space between '(' after '$(' to work around a preprocessor bug when using $( (int)KnownBuiltinDeclName::...).
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot corrected the syntax in the same commit d0bade9b.

review_signals.summary: Reported a regression in tests/autodiff/diff-ptr-type-call.slang due to mishandled IDifferentiablePtr builtin.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot fixed the regression in commit e880ba2b and related commits.

review_signals.summary: Suggested using a descriptive constant instead of hardcoded [KnownBuiltin(0)] in the test.
review_signals.action_taken: A follow‑up commit (4881947) replaced the magic number with a named constant.

review_signals.summary: Asked jkwak-work to approve, indicating maintainer acceptance.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial enum implementation; csyonghe immediately reviewed and requested design changes.
Over several hours, Copilot iterated: first switched to integer storage, then adopted preprocessor syntax with space workaround.
csyonghe reported a regression from manual testing; Copilot fixed it and cleaned up unused enum cases.
gtong-nv requested test improvements; Copilot applied them.
After approvals from gtong-nv and jkwak-work, PR was merged ~4 days after creation.
